covered_report_window: Monday, September 21, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Tuesday, September 22, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: U.S. equities rallied as oil and Treasury yields eased, but Brent remained near $100 and the 10-year yield near 5% after the Federal Reserve's first rate increase since 2023. Rate and fuel volatility are material for discretionary demand, especially RVs, while the broad risk-on tape raises relief-rally risk.

methodology.disparity_definition: Average of (a) mean pairwise direction-score distance normalized from the -100 to +100 range to 0-100 and (b) mean pairwise reversal-risk distance; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied hard timing confirmation, one-decisive-metric scoring, priced-in growth caution, low-bar reversal floors, and disagreement penalties. No new method change was warranted.

upward.note: Third on a relative basis; not a bullish call.

downward.note: Third on a relative downside basis; final call is Neutral.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Towable backlog / margin and FY2027 demand tone
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A collapsing towable backlog and tariff-driven margin pressure leave the FY2027 demand message more likely to disappoint, although a deeply reset bar creates meaningful squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.89 EPS and $2.17B revenue after Q3 guidance cut FY2026 EPS to $3.30-$3.80 and assumed a mid-teens North American retail decline.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A low EPS bar clears, dealer inventories prove lean, and management signals better orders or margin stabilization.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Towable backlog, dealer orders, or gross margin remain weak and FY2027 expectations reset lower.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly an 11.3% move; depressed expectations and target-price upside create sizable relief risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Citi and BMO cut targets immediately before the print; the four-analyst consensus remained mixed-to-positive.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three leaned down; Pass B was less bearish because expectations are already low.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A de-risked share price, resilient domestic comps, and double-digit commercial growth create modest upside potential if margin pressure is no worse than feared.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $54.08 EPS and $6.70B revenue; Q3 posted 4.1% domestic comps and 10.4% commercial-sales growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Domestic comps beat, commercial sales stay double-digit, and operating-margin or LIFO pressure is better than feared.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fine sales quarter is overwhelmed by gross-margin pressure, inventory investment, oil-sensitive DIY weakness, or cautious FY2027 commentary.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 9.6%, well above the 10-year average move of 5.6%; the stock has fallen after three of the last four reports.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Ratings remain broadly bullish, but Oppenheimer, Citi, Wells Fargo, and others cut targets or estimates into the event.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three leaned up with tight dispersion; margin quality capped conviction.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Consensus sits near the upper half of prior sales guidance while prior-quarter orders fell, leaving margin and order commentary vulnerable despite an achievable EPS bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus sources cluster near $0.35-$0.36 EPS and $941M-$962M revenue versus company guidance of $0.33-$0.39 and $928M-$968M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Contract orders rebound, gross margin clears guidance, and cost control supports the full-year EPS range.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Orders stay soft, retail store costs or international weakness compress margins, or the interim leadership team guides cautiously.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 13.5%-15.5%; the prior report produced a 12% gain, so relief upside remains material.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is sparse; one recent quantitative report cut its target to $22 while broader analyst consensus remained only moderately positive.

pass_results.key_metric: contract orders and FY2027 EPS tone

ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Two passes leaned down; one was Neutral because the guide is low and relief potential is high.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Positive Phase 3 data, FDA alignment, and funding through 2029 are constructive, but those facts are known and the half-year financial update may not provide a fresh enough catalyst.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Published consensus is roughly a $0.92-$0.98 loss per share with minimal revenue; investors are focused on the year-end NDA filing and spending cadence.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Management firmly reaffirms the year-end NDA filing, controls burn, and adds favorable regulatory or launch-readiness detail.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Submission timing slips, commercialization spend accelerates, or the absence of new clinical information triggers a sell-the-news reaction.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 8.7%, 1.5 times its recent average earnings move; flow was unclear and event volatility rich.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent analyst tone is strongly bullish, including a Goldman Buy initiation and several post-Phase-3 target increases, raising the expectation bar.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: One Lean Up and two Neutral passes; all agreed that accounting EPS is secondary to regulatory commentary.

qualified_names.reason: Score above 30, reversal risk below 40, high evidence quality, and the lowest disparity.

excluded_high_reversal_or_weak_names.reason: Absolute score qualified, but reversal risk 55 exceeded 40.
Absolute score below 30 and reversal risk 56.
